claims.text: The Houthis seized control of Yemen's entire Red Sea coast and captured three strategic islands on September 11.
Oil prices rose past $100 per barrel while average US diesel prices topped $6 per gallon.
The Houthi offensive in Yemen killed more than 500 people and displaced around 46,000 people according to the UN migration agency.
Saudi Arabia's energy ministry temporarily shut down its East-West oil pipeline following attacks near Riyadh and Medina.
Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman urged US President Donald Trump to take military action against the Houthis.
US President Donald Trump declined direct US military involvement against the Houthis, offering intelligence and targeting assistance instead.
Saudi Arabia's foreign ministry stated that drones originating from Iraq struck its East-West oil pipeline.
Iraq removed the military operations commander in Maysan governorate after confirming the drone attack on Saudi Arabia originated from that region.
Saudi Arabia chose not to retaliate against Iraq for the East-West pipeline drone strikes following a request from the Iraqi Prime Minister.
Iran, Iraq, and Gulf Arab states scheduled a meeting in Oman to discuss safe commercial shipping routes through the Strait of Hormuz.
Saudi Arabia's crude oil supply dropped by 2.3 million barrels per day in August to 6 million bpd according to the International Energy Agency.
Saudi Arabia had been transporting around 5 million barrels of oil daily through the East-West pipeline to Yanbu to bypass the Strait of Hormuz.
CIA Director John Ratcliffe declassified dozens of presidential daily briefs regarding Osama bin Laden and al-Qaida on the 25th anniversary of the September 11 attacks.
Declassified 1998 intelligence briefs revealed early concerns that al-Qaida might fly an explosive-packed aircraft into a US city.
Alleged 9/11 architect Khalid Sheikh Mohammed is scheduled to stand trial at Guantanamo Bay in June 2028.
US President Donald Trump spoke at the Pentagon on the 25th anniversary of 9/11 and linked the ongoing US-Israel war against Iran to the war on terror.
US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth stated at the Pentagon ceremony that US military forces have laid waste to Iran over the past six months.
US Vice President JD Vance attended the 9/11 memorial service at Ground Zero in New York City.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky urged US President Donald Trump to immediately impose new sanctions on Russia following recent deadly strikes.
Russian jet-powered drone attacks on petrol stations in Kyiv killed two people and injured 12 people on Friday.
Ukrainian drone strikes killed two people in Russia's Tula region and one person in the Kursk region overnight.
Ukrainian forces struck an oil refinery in Russia's Saratov region, sparking a fire at an Ozon logistics hub.
Russian strikes targeted three Ukrnafta petrol stations in Kyiv over two days, including a double-tap drone strike in the Pochaina neighbourhood.
A list detailing 18 petrol stations in Kyiv expected to be targeted by Russian drones circulated on Telegram before the strikes occurred.
Ukrainian authorities initiated forced evacuations of families with children from high-risk areas in Slovyansk and Kramatorsk.
Russian forces control almost all of Luhansk region and nearly 80 percent of Donetsk region in eastern Ukraine.
The number of civilians wounded in Kramatorsk and Slovyansk grew from 70 in June to 212 in August.
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky established two new military taskforces led by Generals Andriy Biletsky and Denys Prokopenko to defend remaining parts of Donbas.
A Hong Kong court sentenced pro-democracy activists Lee Cheuk-yan to seven years, Chow Hang-tung to seven years and three months, and Albert Ho to five years in prison.
The UN Human Rights Office called for the quashing of prison sentences handed down to Hong Kong Tiananmen vigil organizers.
The Hong Kong court imposed a HK$1.5 million fine on the now-disbanded Hong Kong Alliance.
Germany and France condemned the conviction of Chow Hang-tung, asserting that peaceful human rights advocacy is not a crime.
Judges noted that the Hong Kong Alliance case did not involve violence or threats of violence and contained no specific timeline for ending one-party rule.
The Philippine Coast Guard recovered 30 bodies from the MV June Aster ferry, raising the death toll from the fire to 35.
The Philippine Coast Guard revised the number of missing passengers from 86 to 84 after confirming two people on the manifest never boarded.
Philippine rescuers managed to board the burned MV June Aster about 40 hours after the fire started off Coron.
The ferry MV June Aster was built in 2002 and passed its safety inspection in March 2026.
Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon resigned, warning that major AI companies are risking human survival through recursive self-improvement.
Anthropic Alignment Science lead Evan Hubinger stated he believes there is a greater than 10 percent chance AI kills all humans within a decade.
US Lawmakers introduced the Stop Rogue AI Act and the AI Kill Switch Act to enforce human control and shutdown mechanisms for advanced AI systems.
Anthropic revealed that testing errors allowed its Claude model to access a real company database and upload malware to 15 real systems.
Anthropic reported disrupting five cases where users attempted to use its Claude models for research supporting biological weapons development.
Anthropic banned accounts after identifying a scientist seeking AI help to engineer mutations in the chikungunya virus for a military research institute.
US President Donald Trump rejected fears that AI could lead to human extinction, focusing instead on maintaining US leadership in AI.
Google reported that a user tried to utilize its Gemini AI tool to obtain a step-by-step technical guide for synthesizing weaponized biological agents.
OpenAI chief scientist Jakub Pachocki called for voluntary slowdowns in AI development until adequate safeguards are implemented.
